evidence: Traupman 72: pulticula ex pōmīs terrestribus, mashed potatoes
Cels. 2.30; Plin. NH 26.58 (Lewis & Short, s.v. pulticula)
terms.comment: No source has a word. Built like Traupman’s mashed potatoes, with pulticula, a thin pap (Celsus, Columella, Pliny), and ex of what it is made from.

phrases.english: Do you want some apple sauce?

sources: Lewis & Short: pulticula · Lewis & Short: malum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 72. Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio and Levi–Bini have no word.
